hero.title: Connect Restaurants, Drivers & Customers in One Platform
hero.subtitle: OrderSync brings together five purpose-built apps sharing one real-time Firebase backend — from ordering to delivery to analytics.

showcase.section_subtitle: Each app is purpose-built for its role, yet they all share one seamless real-time backend.

customer.title: Order Delicious Food
customer.subtitle: Browse menus, track orders in real-time, and pay securely — all from your phone.

onboarding.title: Manage Your Restaurant
onboarding.subtitle: Build menus, create discounts, and manage your entire team from one dashboard.

orders.title: Real-Time Order Board
orders.subtitle: Track orders from received to delivery with live alerts and batch processing.

driver.title: Deliver with Ease
driver.subtitle: Optimized routes, live GPS tracking, and an order marketplace — built for the road.

manager.title: Insights at Your Fingertips
manager.subtitle: Real-time KPIs, sales trends, and a business health score — all in one view.

ecosystem.section_subtitle: All five apps are connected through a single real-time Firebase backend.
ecosystem.step_1_desc: A customer browses restaurants and places an order through the OrderSync app.
ecosystem.step_2_desc: The order appears instantly on the restaurant's kitchen board.
ecosystem.step_3_desc: A nearby driver claims the order and follows optimized routes.
ecosystem.step_4_desc: Real-time analytics and KPIs keep managers informed.

features.section_subtitle: Every feature is designed for reliability, performance, and growth.

realtime.title: Real-time Updates
realtime.desc: Firebase-powered instant sync across all apps simultaneously.

i18n.title: Multi-language
i18n.desc: Full English & Arabic support with bidirectional text.

offline.title: Offline Ready
offline.desc: PWA with service workers for seamless offline access.

routing.title: Route Optimization
routing.desc: Smart delivery routing that saves time and fuel.

analytics.title: Analytics Dashboard
analytics.desc: Real-time KPIs, charts, and business health scores.

discounts.title: Discount Engine
discounts.desc: Item & order-level discounts with complex conditions.

notifications.title: Push Notifications
notifications.desc: Real-time alerts for orders, deliveries, and updates.

maps.title: Live Map Tracking
maps.desc: Real-time GPS tracking for drivers and order locations.

roles.title: Role-based Access
roles.desc: Secure permissions for every user type in the platform.

docs.title: Documentation
docs.subtitle: Technical documentation for the OrderSync platform.

footer.tagline: The complete food delivery platform connecting restaurants, drivers, and customers.
